svg.text: Lane C — ADA_ECU/: one fan-out, then a strict chain into the Python validator
Groups 0.4 and 0.3 (ADA side). 3.0.4.5 is the single place where every shared sample is validated against its schema.
Parallel inside the lane: 2.0.3.2 and 3.0.4.2 share only the toolchain, so they ran side by side. Everything after them is sequential.
3.0.4.1 has no contract dependency at all — it is a toolchain subtask, so lane C could start on day one like lanes A, B and F.
2.0.3.2's implementation commit was mis-tagged [5.0.8.2]: a concurrent session swept its staged files into another commit. Recorded as an anomaly, history not rewritten.
